scope: Corollary 1.3 (Separable products and simultaneous values) of the manuscript “Squarefree values of quartics and power-free values of polynomials” (preprints/Squarefree-values-of-quartics-and-power-free-values-of-polynomials-September-24-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 020 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c032023361538707), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer k ≥ 2. Let F ∈ Z[x] \ {0} be separable over Q, with every nonconstant irreducible factor of degree at most k + 2. If ρF (pk) < pk for every prime p, then SF,k(N) = cF,kN + oF,k(N), cF,k = Y p 1 − ρF (pk) pk ! > 0. More generally, let F = (F1, . . . , Fr), with r ≥ 1, be a fixed family of nonzero integer polynomials, each separable over Q with all nonconstant irreducible factors of degree at most k + 2. Factors may be shared by different Fi. Put Ωp = {a ∈ Z/pk Z : pk | Fi(a) for at least one i}. Let SF,k(N) count the integers 1 ≤ n ≤ N for which every Fi(n) is k-power-free. If #Ωp < pk for every prime p, then SF,k(N) = cF,kN + oF,k(N), cF,k = Y p  1 − #Ωp pk  > 0.
